hero.caption: The "Teatro Puerto Rico" marquee, promoting the movie "Almas del Infierno," starring William Valentin Rico and Carla Pinza, in April of 1966. The movie premiered in 12 theaters throughout the Bronx, Manhattan, and Brooklyn. It was then released in Connecticut, Illinois, New Jersey, and Pennsylvania. The movie was directed and produced by Anthony Felton.
